sentences: Cutting Planes reasons with integer linear inequalities, and its coefficients can encode large numerical information.
The subsystem CP* restricts coefficients to the source's polynomial scale.
The saved question asks whether unrestricted coefficients make the proof system strictly stronger.
A separation would show that numerical magnitude provides an essential reasoning resource beyond the number of inequalities.

The survey summary does not preserve whether strength is compared by proof size or efficient simulation, so the desired relation and coefficient bit-accounting remain necessary parts of the later statement.
